newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD bid specs not expected Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD bid specs not expected Friday.

text.p: Bid specifications for the sale of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) are not expected to be published on Friday, a Planning Ministry spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir had asked the National Development Bank (BNDES) to delay publication of the tender details until next Wednesday, when the National Privatization Council (CND) is scheduled to meet.
Kandir on Thursday testified to the Senate Infrastructure Committee about the CVRD sell-off, expected to be Latin America's biggest privatization to date.
The Planning Ministry spokeswoman could not confirm the reports but said an auction date and minimum price for the block sale would be included in the tender details.

Kandir on Thursday told senators half of the privatisation receipts from the sale of the government's 51 percent stake in CVRD would be ploughed into an infrastructure fund and the rest used to retire government debt.
The move is likely to appease congressional opponents to the sell-off, who are concerned that CVRD's future private sector owners will end its role as an agent of regional development.
